groups.definition: Acquired businesses may lack GAAP-audited financial statements or compatible internal controls, creating risk of financial restatements.
Failure to identify, complete, price or integrate acquisitions and related strategic transactions may result in losses, liabilities or failure to realize expected benefits.
Joint ventures and strategic alliances are complex, capital intensive, require regulatory approvals and offer limited control, risking underperformance.
Failure to execute a broad strategic transformation plan, including capital allocation and cost and quality competitiveness, may harm results.
